# Cv (web)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`public-site`](../../flows/public-site/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Renders one CV at `/cv/<documentId>`: the `page-cv-a` of that id, the `profile` as the contact card and the labels of `cvCommonText`, all read server-side and passed to the client view; a signed-in visitor refetches the data with their token ([public-site flow](../../flows/public-site/FLOW.md)).

## Techniques

Page layout of web RULES "Page layout": `PageCv.tsx` (Server Component) loads through `PageCv.data.ts` (`loadPageCv`, React `cache`, shared by `generateMetadata` and the page); the three queries are read independently (public-site PS-2): a malformed id (`parseCvDocumentId`, no cms-api call) or a `pageCvA` that answers null (never mocked) is `notFound()` (HTTP 404); a failed `PageCvA` read with no mock is the no-CV-live state (HTTP 200, the sanitized `noCvText` or `LAST_RESORT_TEXT.noCvLive`); every state carries the robots tags `CV_ROBOTS_METADATA` (also set by `app/cv/layout.tsx` for the not-found render); the id reaches cms-api only as the `documentId` GraphQL variable; a failed `CvCommonText` leaves the labels out; a failed `Profile` leaves the contact card out. The four query strings (`PageCvA`, `Profile`, `CvCommonText`, `PageCvVisitor`) are in `PageCv.graphql.ts` (the selections written once) and run through `executeGraphql` in `PageCv.data.ts`; a failed profile or text is `null`, a failed `pageCvA` read is the no-CV-live state; the BFF route `GET /api/v1/cv/{documentId}` binds `answerCvRead` from the same file: the session check comes first (`BFF_SESSION_REQUIRED` for any id), then a malformed id, or a `pageCvA` that answers null, is one `BFF_NOT_FOUND` (same body and headers); the id reaches cms-api only as the `documentId` variable. Server data first: anonymous visitors (and everyone's first paint) get the server-rendered data without a request; a signed-in session refetches per actor, signing out falls back to the server data, a failed refetch keeps the server CV with no message. Labels come from `cvCommonText` only (section titles from `summary`, `experiences`, `projects`, `skills`, `educations`, `languages`, `reference`; `teamSize` ("Team of 6"), `technologies`, `achievements`, `webLink` (live link), `projectLink` (repository link), `phone` (reference phone)); a label with no field (contact, loading, masked text, fallback name, link names, unnamed project) is left out, and with a null `cvCommonText` every label is left out. Loading is an empty busy `output`; no name means no `h1`; a masked value is left out when no masked text is provided, never shown raw; links show their URL; unsafe link targets render as text; richtext is sanitized on the server only (D13).

Layout and print (user 2026-11-19, the layout of the CV print demo): a header band (avatar, name, position, two-column contact list with icons), then About me, Experiences (company bar, roles with period on the right), Projects (panels), Skills (grouped by level in the order each level first appears), Educations, Languages, References. Colours are the `cv-*` tokens in `assets/styles/app.css`; every text tone stays readable in black-and-white print. Print button: `CvPrintButton` in `PageCv.client.tsx` (secondary `Button` in the top-right corner of the header band, `print:hidden`, calls `window.print()`; label from `cv-common-text.print`, nothing rendered when the text or label is missing or blank). Print: A4 `@page` with a zero margin in `app.css`: Chrome prints its header and footer (URL, date, title, page number) only inside a page margin, so the 12 mm top and bottom spacing of every page is the padding of the CV body in `PageCv.client.tsx` (`print:py-cv-page-y`, repeated on each page by `box-decoration-break: clone`) and the 10 mm side margin its `print:px-cv-page`; the header band sits outside that body, so it starts at the paper edge, edge to edge. The site header, mobile nav and print button are `print:hidden`. Blocks (company bar, role, project panel, skill group, reference) are kept on one page (`KEEP_TOGETHER_CLASS` = `break-inside-avoid`), headings use `break-after-avoid`; tints print as on screen (`print-color-adjust: exact`); links print as text with no underline. The PDF title is the page title `<name> - <position>`.

## Technologies

React, TanStack Query.

## Entry points

`PageCv` and its `generateMetadata` (rendered and re-exported by `app/cv/[documentId]/page.tsx`; `app/cv/page.tsx` is `notFound()`, `app/cv/layout.tsx` sets the robots metadata), `answerCvRead` (bound by `app/api/v1/cv/[documentId]/route.ts`).

## Where to change what

A field or label (the print button label is `cv-common-text.print`): `PageCv.graphql.ts` (selection and types) and `apis/server/graphql/mocks/PageCv.mock.ts`; a new section: a `<Name>Section.tsx` file plus one line in `PageCv.client.tsx`; contact items and the avatar: `ContactCard.tsx`; colours and paper size: `assets/styles/app.css`; who sees which data: `usePageCvData` in `PageCv.client.tsx`; what is loaded and how it fails: `PageCv.data.ts`.

| `PageCv.graphql.ts` | Query strings of `PageCvA`, `Profile`, `CvCommonText` and `PageCvVisitor`, result types (`PageCvData` holds one `pageCvA`), `isMaskedField`, `sanitizeCvRichtext`; client-safe (exports `PageCvSkill`, `PageCvRole`, `PageCvExperience`, `PageCvProject` +12) |
| `PageCv.tsx` | The page: the CV, or the no-CV-live text (200, no `notFound()`); `generateMetadata` (`<name> - <position>`, `noindex` in the no-CV-live state) (exports `generateMetadata`, `PageCv`) |
| `ProjectsSection.tsx` | The top-level projects of the CV, with safe links and tech stack (exports `ProjectsSection`) |
| `ReferencesSection.tsx` | The references with role and phone; the phone masks by `references.phone` (exports `ReferencesSection`) |
